name: Dorotheus Kosminsky
source:
Dorotheus is a human who was born in sector Six and ended up staying in the Seventh by a twist of fate. His diligence and exactitude caught Sorge's attention, making him her right-hand man. Since then, the young man has responsibly carried out all her orders, despite lacking an implant.

Because of his honorary position, many stay away from Dorotheus, which is why Lesser Mycelium is his constant companion.
